mapper.sql: select r.refund_id, r.refund_no, r.order_id, r.payment_id, r.amount, r.currency_code, r.refund_status, r.reason, r.provider_refund_id, r.requested_at, r.completed_at, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, r.remark, o.order_no from refunds r left join orders o on o.order_id = r.order_id
mapper.select: where r.order_id = #{orderId} order by r.refund_id desc

select ifnull(sum(r.amount), 0) from refunds r inner join orders o on o.order_id = r.order_id where r.refund_status = 'SUCCEEDED' and r.completed_at is not null and date(r.completed_at) > date_sub(curdate(), interval #{days} day) and o.shop_id = #{shopId}
mapper.insert: insert into refunds (refund_no, order_id, payment_id, amount, currency_code, refund_status, reason, provider_refund_id, requested_at, completed_at, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{refundNo}, #{orderId}, #{paymentId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{amount}, #{currencyCode}, #{refundStatus}, #{reason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{providerRefundId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{requestedAt}, #{completedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{createBy,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, sysdate(), #{remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.select: select r.refund_no as refundNo, r.order_id as orderId, o.order_no as orderNo, r.amount as amount, r.currency_code as currencyCode, r.refund_status as refundStatus, r.reason as reason, r.remark as remark, r.requested_at as requestedAt, r.completed_at as completedAt from refunds r inner join orders o on o.order_id = r.order_id where o.customer_id = #{customerId} order by r.refund_id desc
mapper.update: update orders set after_sale_status = #{status}, update_time = sysdate() where order_id = #{orderId}
